svg.title: What can we learn?
svg.desc: The same richly detailed garden with ten numbered pots, six with shoots and four without, a fixed gardener, wooden bench, fence, watering can, seed tray and tools. What can we learn? A clearly labelled annotation panel records both outcomes and asks what information is missing.
svg.text: A question is not an explanation.
Ask questions; do not invent causes.
Of ten seedlings, six grew and four did not.
Same garden. Same outcome. Different attention.
All 10 pots remain visible. Only the editorial emphasis changes.
